name: permission-negotiator
title: Permission Negotiator
description: A single-capability permission ask, requested in context instead of dumped upfront, switchable between two real examples: microphone (typed-note fallback) and camera (a genuine live video preview, mirrored, bound to the real stream, with a palette-color-avatar fallback). Click "Try it" and it asks your real browser with a genuine getUserMedia call, not a fake dialog. Decline either one and the feature keeps working in its fallback rather than breaking, with a quiet, always-available "Enable" link, no re-ask nagging, no dead end either way.
